display_name: Obstructive/Mixed Apnea-Hypopnea Index (Non-Supine): (Obstructive apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal +mixed apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with >= 3% oxygen desaturation or with arousal) / hour of sleep in non-supine position from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - Apnea hypopnea index (3% desats) in other
calculation: 60*(oarop + oanop + marop + manrop + hroa3 + hnroa3)/(remepop + nremepop)
